spec.title: Node monitor
spec.description: Synthetic dashboard of the importer tests.

spec.name: node
spec.label: Node
spec.definition: SELECT DISTINCT node FROM demo_chain.nodes ORDER BY node

spec.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT node
FROM demo_chain.nodes
ORDER BY node
SELECT DISTINCT region FROM demo_chain.nodes WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)

SELECT
  $__timeInterval(ts) AS t,
  node,
  sum(weight) AS weight
FROM demo_chain.node_weight
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND ts >= $__fromTime AND ts <= $__toTime
  AND node IN (${node})
GROUP BY t, node
ORDER BY t -- step $__interval_s s

SELECT node, name, weight, ratio, status, region
FROM demo_chain.nodes
WHERE ('${account}' = '' OR account = '${account}')
  AND env = '${env}'
  AND region LIKE '${region}'
  AND node IN ([[node]])
ORDER BY weight DESC
LIMIT ${top_n}

SELECT toDate(ts) AS day, sum(weight) AS weight
FROM demo_chain.node_weight
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day

SELECT node, sum(weight) AS weight
FROM demo_chain.node_weight
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY node
SELECT node, ratio FROM demo_chain.nodes ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT day, node, weight FROM demo_chain.daily_weight WHERE $__timeFilter(day)
SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS t, node, weight FROM demo_chain.node_weight WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
SELECT * FROM demo_chain.t WHERE ts > now() - $__range_s AND x = ${node:json}
